notes: US store (USD). Banner and shipping policy: free standard shipping on footwear orders over $150, duties and tariffs paid by NPS Solovair, dispatched via DHL (https://us.nps-solovair.com/policies/shipping-policy).
Refund policy: returns form within 30 days of receipt, unworn; a $15.00 DHL Express return charge is deducted from refunds, not from exchanges (https://us.nps-solovair.com/policies/refund-policy).

History: NPS co-operative in Wollaston; from 1959 NPS made air-cushioned-sole boots for Griggs and for 35 years produced footwear sold as 'Dr Martens by Solovair' under licence; registered the Solovair name in 1994; Goodyear-welted construction used in all footwear; handmade start to finish in the UK; since 1881 (https://us.nps-solovair.com/pages/history).
Sizes on the boot feed run 4 Mens / 5 Womens to 15 Mens / 16 Womens (https://us.nps-solovair.com/collections/boots/products.json).
